nobox.final_span: never rang more true. Stories which have been passed down between generations, border kids going from El Segundo to Santa Monica Pier and their first Tito’s taco will begin to make sense once tasters put their hands on anything; be it the warm “horchata,” the freshly made soft, hard shells and debut a flavor palette especially conducive to taco-eating, which in turn conducts to a proverbial sensation which Gold, claims is, “like taking a cold plunge or getting stung by a thousand bees!” In point of fact, everyone from Johnny Depp to Bill Clinton has gone to Tito’s and left without being disappointed. And at right under three dollars each - after thirty years, and being featured in over forty movies - let us kidnap the legend that is John Belushi and give the Tito’s taco business to the original Bever
